description: The Karnataka Cabinet approved free cultivation services for farmers owning up to three acres. A drone testing facility will be established in Chikkaballapur for advanced technology. An Artificial Intelligence Hub will be set up at IIIT-B for training and support. Women beneficiaries of the Shakti scheme will receive a new Shakti Smart Card. The state also approved a new textile policy aiming for significant investment.
body_lead: Listen to this article in summarized format Under the Chief Minister's Negila Yogi scheme, the government will hire private tractors to cultivate the land of eligible farmers. If required, it will purchase tractors for use under the scheme, Parameshwara said. "We are introducing the Chief Minister's Negila Yogi (tiller ascetic) scheme. There are villages where five or so people own tractors, who cultivate their land and leave the tractors idle. The government will hire those tractors and use them to cultivate other farmers' land," Parameshwara told reporters after the Cabinet meeting.
